filters.basis: The table holds M101, M51 and M96; these are M51's rows.

frame.converter: Each sky position onto the midplane of the inclined disc the image layers are baked on (recipe.json), through the image-layer bake's own intersection.

discThickness.basis: The stellar disc's exponential scale height as its scale length over 7.3, the mean flattening Kregel et al. (2002) measured for edge-on discs, with S4G's disc scale length (Salo et al. 2015), 84.2″ = 3.40 kpc: 466 pc. For young objects it is an upper value. Each row's own height is drawn, not measured.

meaning: Planetary nebula candidates of M51 from Feldmeier et al.'s (1997) [O III] survey: one dot per nebula at its catalogue position.

appearance.note: Presentation only: the planetary-nebula color M31's and M33's dots share. Each dot takes its tone and half its color from the photograph under it (packages/bake/cli/prepare-catalogue-points.mts).
